categories.title: Core concept / metaphor
categories.q: What overall metaphor or concept does this website's design express?

options.editor: styled like source code open in a code editor: line numbers, file names, syntax-colored labels
options.terminal: styled like a command-line terminal: prompts, ASCII banners, typed commands, monospace on dark
options.os_desktop: styled like a desktop operating system or file browser: windows, icons, docks, file trees
options.datasheet: styled like an engineering catalog or spec sheet: spec tables, figure captions, part numbers, technical rules
options.lab_notebook: styled like a research log or academic publication: dated entries, papers, figures, citations
options.editorial: styled like a magazine: typography-led layout with large type and photography
options.garden_index: a minimal personal index or digital garden: plain lists of writing and projects, little decoration
options.product_landing: a polished product marketing landing page: hero headline, product screenshots, logo walls, call-to-action buttons
options.playground: a playful toy, game or experimental playground with whimsical or interactive elements
options.object_brand: a physical hardware or object brand: device renders and product photography lead
options.manual_book: styled like a printed book or manual: table of contents, chapters, ornaments, numerals

categories.title: Surface / background
categories.q: What is the dominant page background?

options.warm_dark: dark brown, olive or warm charcoal
options.paper: warm cream, beige or off-white paper
options.color_field: a saturated color (purple, yellow, orange, blue...)

categories.title: Color strategy
categories.q: How is color used beyond the background and text?

options.monochrome: no accent color at all, only greys/black/white
options.single_signal: one accent color used sparingly for links, status or one button
options.category_pastels: several soft accent colors of similar brightness, each marking a category or section
options.neon_glow: glowing neon colors, gradients and light effects
options.duotone: a two-color printed feel (e.g. ink plus one spot color, tinted images)
options.bold_brand: large blocks of a strong saturated brand color
options.imagery_color: color comes mainly from photos or illustrations, UI itself is neutral

categories.title: Type system
categories.q: Which typeface system dominates the page?

options.all_mono: almost everything set in a monospace font
options.mono_plus_sans: monospace for labels and metadata plus a clean sans-serif for body or headlines
options.serif_plus_mono: serif headlines or body combined with monospace labels
options.serif_editorial: serif typefaces lead the page, bookish or editorial
options.grotesk_swiss: neutral grotesque sans-serif (Helvetica/Inter-like), Swiss and clean
options.pixel_bitmap: pixel or bitmap display font visible
options.rounded_playful: rounded, chunky or hand-drawn playful lettering
options.system_plain: plain default system or browser fonts, unstyled

categories.title: Type scale
categories.q: How large is the typography overall?

options.micro: everything is small (body-size or smaller), quiet, no big headline
options.moderate: a modest headline, mostly normal-size text
options.display: a huge headline or name dominates the first screen

categories.title: Page skeleton
categories.q: What is the page layout structure?

options.narrow_column: one narrow centered column of content
options.sidebar_sticky: a sidebar or a split layout with a fixed identity column beside scrolling content
options.multi_column_index: several text columns side by side forming an index
options.card_grid: a grid of cards, tiles or bento boxes
options.gutter_rail: a code-editor style gutter or rail with line numbers or a vertical guide line on the left
options.spatial_canvas: a free spatial layout: horizontal scrolling, scattered items, desktop or canvas

categories.title: Information density
categories.q: How much information is packed into one screen?

options.airy: very little content per screen, lots of empty space
options.balanced: a moderate amount of content with comfortable spacing
options.dense: a lot of text, links or data per screen, tight spacing

categories.title: Hero (first screen)
categories.q: What occupies the first screen (the hero)?

options.text_intro: a short text introduction or bio, no big visual
options.kv_spec: a key-value spec list or table about the person or product
options.statement_type: one big typographic statement or name
options.product_visual: a product screenshot, UI mockup or benchmark chart
options.interactive_artifact: a live interactive canvas, simulation, animation or ASCII art piece
options.photo_object: a photograph or render of a physical object or place
options.terminal_prompt: a terminal window or command prompt
options.list_first: no hero; the page opens straight into a list of entries

categories.title: Navigation
categories.q: What kind of navigation does the site use?

options.top_minimal: a minimal top bar with a few text links
options.top_full: a full product top navigation with menus and buttons
options.tabs_boxed: boxed tabs or bordered buttons as navigation
options.toc_leaders: a table of contents with dot leaders or numerals
options.icon_labels: navigation items with icons plus labels and small sub-labels
options.command_terminal: typed commands, a command palette or terminal input
options.inline_links: links embedded in prose, no real navigation bar

categories.title: How work is listed
categories.q: How are projects, posts or entries presented?

options.dated_list: a simple list of titles with dates
options.year_table: a table with a year or date column and rows
options.tree_log: a tree or git-log style structure with connector lines
options.tile_grid: a grid of logo or icon tiles

options.rule_label: a small label sitting on a thin horizontal rule line

categories.title: Texture & ornament
categories.q: Which surface textures or ornaments are visible?

options.flat: completely flat, no texture or ornament
options.dot_grain: a dot pattern, noise or grain on the background
options.grid_lines: visible grid lines, crosshairs or frame guides
options.ticks_marks: ruler ticks, registration or crop marks
options.line_art: thin line art, wireframes or generative lines
options.glow_gradient: soft gradients, glows or light streaks
options.ascii_texture: ASCII characters used as image or texture
options.boxes_borders: bordered boxes, outlines or offset shadows

options.no_images: no images at all, text only
options.product_photos: photos of physical products or objects

categories.title: Motion & interactivity
categories.q: How much motion and interactivity does the site rely on?

options.single_hero_anim: one animated or live element, rest static
options.interactive_figures: interactive figures, sliders or demos inside content
options.heavy_3d: heavy 3D, WebGL or scroll-driven animation throughout

categories.title: Personality / voice
categories.q: What personality does the design project?

a01-brittanychiang.notes: brittanychiang.com. Navy, split layout: sticky left (name, role, nav, socials) + scrolling right column Notable: Sticky identity column; nav items with a **line that extends on active**; experience rows = `date │ role · company ↗ │ desc │ pill tags`, whole row is the hover target.

a02-rauno.notes: rauno.me. Light grey canvas, horizontally scrolling cards, huge grotesk, yellow/orange discs Notable: **Ruler tick-marks** as the scroll indicator; one oversized type moment per card.

a03-paco.notes: paco.me. Dark, ~13px text, 3 columns: Building / Projects / Writing, then a "Now" paragraph Notable: Proof that **tiny type + a strict list grid** reads as confident. Title + one-line description per item, nothing else.

a04-leerob.notes: leerob.com. Small serif, 2-col notes list, blog list with right-aligned dates, one illustration Notable: Right-aligned dates in a hairline list; one big illustration as the only image.

a05-emilkowalski.notes: emilkowal.ski. White, single narrow column: Today / Projects / Writing Notable: Section labels as tiny grey headings; every item = title + 1 line.

a06-antfu.notes: antfu.me. Dark centered column; inline icon chips for projects in prose ("Creator of ⓥ Vitest, ⓢ Slidev…"); faint generative plum-tree lines in background Notable: **Inline logo chips inside sentences**; generative line art at ~5% opacity behind content.

a07-rsms.notes: rsms.me. Grey bg, orange dot logo, 3 columns: Projects / Thoughts / bio Notable: Dense 3-column index with faded inline dates.

a08-jakub.notes: jakub.kr. Dark, avatar + name, projects with small icon tiles, writing list with category under title Notable: Category as a second dim line under each title.

a09-benji.notes: benji.org. Tiny light page, writing as a table: year │ title │ date Notable: **Year column only on the first row of each year** (table-like grouping).

a10-samuelkraft.notes: samuelkraft.com. Dark, project cards = dark tiles with a centered app icon Notable: Uniform dark tiles with one centered glyph — works for repos without screenshots.

a11-delba.notes: delba.dev. Light serif, work list + sidebar "About me" with photo Notable: Two-column: content list + narrow sticky bio.

a12-jhey.notes: jhey.dev. Black + grid, bold serif "Making your ideas click", **mono status lines with emoji bullets**, pink highlighted span Notable: Status lines: `◆ CHILLIN' IN PUTNAM`, `◆ NO RECENT GAME` — a "now" widget in mono caps.

a13-joshwcomeau.notes: joshwcomeau.com. Playful 3D rainbow hero, article list + category sidebar Notable: Popular-content sidebar with arrow bullets. (Too whimsical overall.)

a14-mitchellh.notes: mitchellh.com. Navy, tiny sidebar nav (About/Writing/Misc) with green dot, serif prose Notable: Founder-grade restraint: one paragraph bio, nothing else.

a15-taniarascia.notes: taniarascia.com. Left sidebar w/ pixel-emoji nav icons; "A brief timeline" with **mono year ranges**; posts with `#tag` chips; "Shelves" cards with counts Notable: Timeline as `1998–2006  text` rows; **pixel-icon nav**; counts on collection cards.

b01-ciechanowski.notes: ciechanow.ski. Narrow prose interleaved with full-width interactive WebGL figures + sliders Notable: The gold standard for **"the hero artifact is a working piece of your domain."** A draggable quantization / tokens-per-second demo is our version.

b02-wattenberger.notes: wattenberger.com. Huge heavy serif name with gradient; bold-italic bio; "I'M THINKING ABOUT…" list; WIP sticker Notable: A tiny-caps label over a list of current interests.

b03-maggieappleton.notes: maggieappleton.com. Serif display; essays as illustrated cards + notes list with growth-stage icons Notable: **Status icons per note** (seedling/budding/evergreen) — maps to project maturity (prototype/shipped/maintained).

b04-jzhao.notes: jzhao.xyz. Navy Quartz garden; **dithered image banner**; tiny departure-board widget (clock + status) Notable: Dithering as image treatment; a small live "board" widget in the corner.

b05-gwern.notes: gwern.net. Dense serif, small-caps headings, 3-col link lists, ✻ ornament dividers, boxed tab nav Notable: Small caps + ornaments = scholarly density without clutter.

k06-finnh.notes: finnh.ca (Finn). White monochrome site, Bayer/Atkinson dithered project images and 3D object, project cards with mono dates, playful hardware projects.

k07-ineedmorecoffee.notes: I Need More Coffee (Sohal Sudheer). Dark serif blog, narrow column, recent posts and favorites as dated lists, dithered black-and-white images in posts.

k08-redblobgames.notes: Red Blob Games (Amit Patel). Interactive visual explanations of algorithms; homepage is a grid of diagram thumbnails, red header band.

k09-nanfyi.notes: Not a Number (Nanda Syahrasyad). Interactive CS blog: serif titles with line-icon per post in a list, sticky left intro column, light grey.

k10-maximeheckel.notes: Maxime Heckel's article on dithering and retro shading: dark, centered prose with live WebGL demos showing CRT, pixelation and dithering effects with toggles.

k11-gabx.notes: gabx.io. Light-mode terminal homepage: cat readme.md, ls -la, tab completion, a profile photo pane, all monospace and readable.

k12-zoomie.notes: Andrew Arderne. Orange color-field page, huge bold and outlined display type (SOFTWARE ENGINEER), duotone portrait, vertical timeline arrow.

k13-eloquentjs.notes: Eloquent JavaScript (Marijn Haverbeke). A book's homepage: cover art, numbered chapter table of contents grouped into parts, small-caps serif headings.
